sections.indications_and_usage: INDICATIONS For the temporary relief of diarrhea, gas, cramping, fatigue, minor joint pain or swelling, or occasional headache due to sensitivity to phenolic compounds found in foods or other products.*
sections.dosage_and_administration: DIRECTIONS Place drops under tongue 30 minutes before/after meals. Adults and children 12 years and over: Take 10 drops up to 3 times per day. Consult a physician for use in children under 12 years of age.
sections.warnings_and_cautions: WARNINGS In case of overdose, get medical help or contact a poison control center right away. Keep out of the reach of children. If pregnant or breastfeeding, ask a healthcare professional before use.
